class.name: Beast Slayer Class
lore: Choose the Beast Slayer Class

skills.name: Spatial Awareness
lore: Detect nearby enemies in 15 blocks and highlight them.

skills.name: Slice N Dice
lore: Unleash a rapid chain of blade strikes:
First Strike: A quick slash forward and a spinning slash
that hits twice.
Second Strike: A quick slash forward and a spinning slash
that hits twice.
Third Strike: Slash three times in a row with both blades.
Fourth Strike: A short dash forward with a pierce followed
by an upper slash and a down slash.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Devour
lore: Release two simultaneous horizontal slashes outwards, ripping
away with savagery power and heal yourself.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Palisade Bite
lore: Lunge onto your enemies and unleash a horizontal slice with both
blades to fix onto the targets. Then you lunge backwards, pulling
back the blades and ripping off the enemies, leaving them to bleed.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🗡 {bleeddamage} Bleed Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Sudden Throwing Strike
lore: Throw both of your blades in a spinning motion at an enemy.
The blades come back to you after a short time.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Crazy Cutting
lore: Leap up and slice everything in all directions while in mid-air
and repeat the slices while coming down to the surface.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Explosive Rush
lore: Inhale energy and release a shockwave at your feet, charging towards
your opponent at blinding speeds, ignoring all incoming attacks.
During the charge, all enemies in contact get sliced and left with
bleeding. After the charge ends, dash forwards 3 times in a row,
slashing through all enemies in your path and leaving them to bleed.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🗡 {bleeddamage} Bleed Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
